## Pull request overview

This PR fixes a Next.js 16 TypeScript build error by adding the required HTML document structure (`<html>` and `<body>` tags) to the root layout. Next.js 16 requires root layouts to return a complete HTML document rather than just returning children directly.

**Changes:**
- Added `<html>` and `<body>` wrapper elements to `apps/docs/app/layout.tsx`
- Included `suppressHydrationWarning` attribute on the html tag
- Set language attribute to "en" on the html element
